title: PRACTICE: From Experience to Expertise in Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.30760v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent studies have shown that multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can serve as embodied agents, translating language instructions and visual observations into executable plans. However, building agents that can continually improve through interaction and rapidly adapt to their environments remains challenging. Summing up experience from past interaction trajectories provides a promising solution, but existing experience-based methods often rely on manually designed prompting workflows to extract and update skills. Such fixed procedures may struggle to learn updated skills from new and diverse experiences. We introduce PRACTICE, which trains a skill learner to discover and maintain a persistent skill library from past interaction trajectories while keeping the task executor frozen. translated_title: PRACTICE：从经验到专长——自我进化的具身智能体
translated_abstract: 近期研究表明，多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）可以作为具身智能体，将语言指令和视觉观察转化为可执行的计划。然而，构建能够通过交互持续改进并快速适应环境的智能体仍然具有挑战性。从过去的交互轨迹中总结经验提供了一个有前景的解决方案，但现有的基于经验的方法通常依赖手动设计的提示工作流程来提取和更新技能。这种固定的程序可能难以从新的、多样的经验中学习更新技能。我们提出了PRACTICE，它训练一个技能学习器从过去的交互轨迹中发现并维护一个持久的技能库，同时保持任务执行器冻结。给定历史积累的技能和传入的轨迹，技能学习器会生成结构化的批量编辑操作，以添加、精炼、合并或删除技能。
tldr: 提出PRACTICE框架，通过训练技能学习器自动从交互轨迹中发现并维护持久技能库，利用结构化批量编辑实现具身智能体的自我进化，摆脱了手动设计提示工作流程的局限。
en_tdlr: PRACTICE trains a skill learner to automatically discover and maintain a persistent skill library from interaction trajectories via structured batch-edits, enabling self-evolving embodied agents without manually designed prompting workflows.
